title: Dotfiles part 5: per-machine git identity
snippet: A shared gitconfig includes ~/.gitconfig.local, so each machine sets its own email and signing key.

title: Dotfiles part 4: halving zsh startup time
snippet: Swapping nvm for fnm and lazy-loading thefuck cut a new shell from about 1.5s to 0.8s.

title: Dotfiles part 3: an idempotent install script
snippet: bin/install sets up a new Mac in six steps and does nothing harmful when run again.

title: Dotfiles part 2: loading machine profiles in zsh
snippet: One file names the active profile. The load order matters because oh-my-zsh reads its plugins array once.

title: Dotfiles part 1: a public core with private machine profiles
snippet: My dotfiles split into a public repo for shared shell config and one private repo per machine.
